formulaBlock.normalization: No split synonym entries; no markers. Normalized positions (ID-2) equal packet positions 1-21.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic is the ether-type Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3 and Coco-Glucoside@4, no reinforcing strong anionic (settled C1 core). Sodium Sulfate@17 is an inorganic salt, not a surfactant. Formula-only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system (cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@9, prominent) plus light routes (weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate@7; humectants Panthenol@12, Glycerin@14). C2 not met: no silicone, no payload_lipid, no pearlizing/fatty route. Neighbor low: the guar is the only substantive route.

reset: Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (strong anionic, ether type)
excluded: Sorbitan Caprylate@8 (C8 sorbitan ester used as preservation booster/co-emulsifier; not a persistent lipid, no deposition family)
Zinc PCA@11 (zinc salt, no deposition family)

wLineRecord.plausibility: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) positions 7-18 hold no C3 cleansing surfactant (Sorbitan Caprylate is in no C3 class), no alkanolamide, no pearlizing wax.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families present (cationic guar plus a weak refatter); guar prominent.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single cationic guar and one weak refatter; no silicone, payload_lipid, protein or film former; buffered SLES chassis with two buffers gives moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the second family is a single weak_refatter (Glyceryl Oleate@7), and the only real depositing system, guar@9, is listed after the capped active Piroctone Olamine@6 and faces a C1 moderate reset with nothing converging, so combined residue plausibly stays below noticeable.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (6.6): one light cationic system plus a weak refatter against moderate reset; W2 reason recorded; no W-RICH.

careDirection.limitation: Humectants are late; generic conditioning distinguishes neither moisture nor repair. Distinctive route is Piroctone Olamine@6 (plus Zinc PCA@11).

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Recognized dandruff active Piroctone Olamine@6 points to a scalp role that needs an E2 dandruff claim.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction null (hidden). Formula compatible with scalp_active (dandruffSupport supported) if a dandruff claim exists; lengths care nonspecific. Provisional general.
focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional general pending claims; scalp_active the most plausible neighbor.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible. Provisional.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default regular: claims hidden. dandruffSupport supported, so treatment fires with a qualifying E2 dandruff claim graded moderate/high (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.csaRoute: CSA met by listed prominent routes: comfort Panthenol@12; humectant/refatting Glyceryl Oleate@7, Panthenol@12, Glycerin@14. MB not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 excludes it.
scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional not_targeted: SC1 positioning hidden; CSA formula half met via listed prominent routes. Fragrance declared at the E3 point (Parfum@19); no cooling agent. Dandruff-unit wording would not count as SC1 (E2a, E2b).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: the complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine@6 (Section 11). Zinc PCA@11 is not a recognized active and adds nothing.
